system.description:
This Charm allows the Dragon-Blood to exercise his larcenous intent when stripped of his tools or even the clothes on his back.

The Exalt can fashion out of solidified Essence simple tools for picking locks, cutting through bars or jimmying doors. The Charm gives no particular benefit to the Exalt's attempt. It simply gives him access to tools of the trade he otherwise would not possess. The Charm requires a separate use for each individual Larceny task. If the Exalt summoned a hacksaw to cut through bars, it would last for the duration of the attempt. If, after bypassing the bars, the Dragon-Blood was confronted with a lock to be picked or even a separate set of bars to cut through, he would have to activate the Charm again.
